QuestInfo.name: Lost Moonbeam
QuestInfo.0: Silver is watching the rainfall anxiously. What meaning does rain have in the village? Why is everyone so anxious? Ask him.
QuestInfo.1: Silver says it only rains when a fox is crying, but there are no foxes in town who are shedding even a tear. He thinks that something must have happened to Moonbean, wherever she is. She was last seen at the Fox Tree, so go there to pick up her trail.
QuestInfo.2: You learned that rain only falls in the fox village when one of them is crying. You are out to track Moonbeam down in cast it's her. You found #p3002014#, Moonbeam's pet, under the Fox Tree. \r\n\r\n

0.0: It simply never rains in our village. If it does, that means #ra fox is crying somewhere#k. It takes more than a few tears to bring a downpour like this. What worries me is that #r#p3002000##k is missing.
0.1: No one in town is crying, so it must be Moonbeam. She hasn't cried a tear since she lost her mother and father, though. Something awful must have happened. Can you find her?

yes.0: It's all so terrible. Losing Moonbeam's parents was such a tragedy, and I couldn't bear to lose her, too. Let's focus on finding her for now. She was last seen under the #rFox Tree#k.

no.0: This is way too much rain for one little fox to make. We need to find her now!

0.msg: #p3002014#? Why are you all alone? ...No, Moonbeam doesn't even have her spirit!

1.msg: Maybe she left clues around here. I'll have to take a look around.

default.0: I don't know how I'm going to live if something happens to Moonbeam.
